headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, led by AI‑driven revenue gains.
summary: TCS and HCLTech reported double‑digit revenue growth and strong operating margins. Tech Mahindra and Wipro also grew, though Wipro saw a slight profit dip. Several peers (Infosys, LTM, OFSS, Coforge) have not released Q2 numbers yet, limiting full sector visibility.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: TCS, HCLTech and Wipro highlighted AI revenue contributions and new AI‑native deals, driving higher margins.

themes.title: Robust deal wins
themes.detail: TCS secured $9.6 bn of new contracts and HCLTech added $3.26 bn, underscoring continued demand for digital transformation.

leaders.why: Highest revenue at ₹73,188 cr and 24% operating margin, with strong AI and deal‑win performance.
21% YoY profit rise, AI revenue jump of 78% YoY and clear FY27 guidance.

laggards.why: Revenue grew modestly (9% YoY) and net profit fell 1.9% YoY, with no Q2 revenue figure from the exchange feed.
Revenue growth modest (15.6% YoY) and margin data missing, indicating weaker momentum.
